propositions: When plan review reuse fires on an unchanged plan (PASS path), the returned verdict currently synthesizes empty blocking/advisory/coaching/indeterminate lists instead of replaying the stored REVIEW_RESULT sidecar content, causing real advisory findings and coaching from the last review to be lost in CLI output.

The BLOCK path (verdict_reuse) already replays blocking/advisory/coaching from the latest sidecar with a reused notation, establishing the desired behavior; the PASS path (idempotent_reuse) must be brought into conformance.

Plan review reuse must read the stored REVIEW_RESULT sidecar and populate advisory/coaching/indeterminate/coverage.counts from it when the sidecar matches the material fingerprint, while fail-open to empty lists if the sidecar is absent, unreadable, mismatched, or contradictory.

The CLI notation must unmistakably state that rendered findings are the last review's result replayed because the plan is unchanged (not a fresh LLM run), include the stored review's recency anchor (verified_at_sha/timestamp) when available, and keep the --force pointer for re-review.

Machine-readable output must maintain coverage.llm_ran=False, existing idempotent_skip/verdict_reuse flags, and runner='reused', with replayed findings in the same fields a fresh review would populate, passing structured validation.
New tests must verify stored advisory/coaching replay on PASS reuse, fail-open behavior when sidecar is unreadable, and CLI notation rendering, with all existing reuse tests remaining unweakened.
